summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong listing rules, detailing changes in issued shares and treasury shares. The filing reports multiple tranches of share repurchases for cancellation between March 20 and April 15, 2026, with prices ranging from approximately USD 6.55 to 7.14 per share. Board recommendation is not stated; no external advisors mentioned. Mechanically, these are open-market buybacks to be cancelled, reducing share count. This is a capital return to shareholders via buybacks. What to watch: pace of future repurchases and impact on EPS.
